rows.reasoning: At the federal level only own words can seat a chair, so his H.R. 5 vote and his S. 2702 sponsorship cannot. His own words, "Parents should never be kept in the dark about their own kids", place him on the parents-informed side but do not separate "Require schools to tell parents when parents ask", "Require schools to notify parents" and "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns."
